rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance – Allowable Annual Rent Increase
rules.requirement: The Rent Board publishes the allowable annual rent increase for tenancies covered by the Rent Ordinance. The figure for March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.status_basis: Annual rate published by the Rent Board; period start is not an effective date of the law.

rules.title: San Francisco Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on tenant security deposits at the rate set annually by the Rent Board. The rate for March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027 is 4.2%.
rules.citation: Rent Board Current Rates report (Security Deposit Interest)
rules.status_basis: Annual rate published by the Rent Board.
rules.quoted_span:
Security Deposit Interest:
4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027

rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance Sections 37.9A and 37.9C – Relocation Payments
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted for owner or relative move-in, demolition, temporary capital improvement work or substantial rehabilitation (37.9C), or under the Ellis Act (37.9A), are owed relocation payments. Amounts are per tenant, capped per unit, with an add-on for elderly, disabled or minor-child households.
rules.key_value: 37.9C: $8,245.00 per tenant, max $24,733.00 per unit, plus $5,497.00 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor child, for notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27; Ellis Act: $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90
rules.status_basis: Annual amounts by date of service of notice; not an effective date.
